meta.name: citation-management
meta.description: Comprehensive citation management for academic research. Search OpenAlex, PubMed, and Google Scholar for papers, extract accurate metadata, validate citations, and generate properly formatted BibTeX entries. This skill should be used when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or ensure reference accuracy in scientific writing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检索学术文献并生成规范参考文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果平时需要大量检索和引用学术文献
copy.tagline_en: Find papers and generate correctly formatted citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently search and cite academic literature

howto.what: 它会帮你搜索 Google Scholar、PubMed 上的学术论文,把 DOI、PMID、arXiv ID 等编号转成规范的 BibTeX 条目;元数据缺失时自动上网补齐,还能格式化、去重和校验参考文献。做文档时它还会考虑配上科学示意图。
howto.when: 当你要查找论文、验证引用信息、把 DOI 转成 BibTeX,或核对参考文献是否准确时,这个技能就会被使用。

say.text: 帮我搜一下 CRISPR 基因编辑的论文,导出成 BibTeX。
say.note: 它会搜索论文并生成 BibTeX 文件。

say.text: 校验并整理我的 references.bib,补全缺失的字段。
say.note: 它会检查缺失字段、去重并统一格式。

howto.what_en: Finds papers via Google Scholar and PubMed, converts DOIs, PMIDs, or arXiv IDs into BibTeX, fills missing metadata through web search, formats/deduplicates/validates bibliography files, and may add scientific diagrams to documents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or check reference accuracy in scientific writing.

say_en.text: Find papers on CRISPR gene editing and export them as BibTeX.
say_en.note: Searches Google Scholar and PubMed, then outputs BibTeX.
Extracts metadata from CrossRef and formats an entry.

say_en.text: Validate my references.bib, fill in missing fields, and deduplicate.
say_en.note: Checks gaps, removes duplicates, and standardizes formatting.
